requirement.evidence: At the expiration of a lease or at the termination of a lease of a periodic tenant, no landlord may request or receive a percentage increase in rent which is greater than 5% or the percentage difference between the consumer price index three months prior to the expiration or termination of the lease and three months prior to the commencement of the lease term, whichever is less.
requirement.note: Card's plain-language summary matches the cap and the one-increase-per-12-months rule, including regardless of tenant turnover.

key_value.evidence: No more than one such cost-of-living rental increase in any one twelve-month period shall be permitted irrespective of the number of different tenants occupying said housing space during said twelve-month period.
key_value.note: Lesser of 5% or CPI change and one increase per 12 months are both stated.
